properties.name: COMPOSITION, not one factory — Anthony's refinement, and skill_lint already contains the evidence: three contracts the code itself calls "the same shape" twice, and a rule the instructions apply to EVERY skill that is carried by 1 of 23 and enforced for 1 of 23
properties.statement:
ANTHONY, 2026-08-28, correcting the framing of this node: *"I didn't mean we have only one factory, I was actually thinking of multiple factories. like in python, a class can inherit a class which can inherit a class (I actually prefer class composition versus class inheritance). so a particular class of skills inherits a set of classes that determine what that skill should have. different skills inherit (or are composed) of different class attributes."*

⚠️ **THE OPTIONS ON THIS NODE ALL ASSUMED ONE FACTORY**, stamping every member of a class identically. That is not what he asked for and it is a materially weaker idea. This is option (f): COMPOSABLE ATTRIBUTE CLASSES, each skill composed of the ones it actually owes.

═══ ⭐ THE EVIDENCE IS ALREADY IN `skill_lint.py`, IN ITS OWN COMMENTS ═══

Three per-skill contracts exist — `ASK_CONTRACT`, `LINK_CONTRACT`, `OPTIMIZE_CONTRACT` — each a dict of {label: required phrase}, each bound to ONE skill by its OWN loop (lines 1015, 1031, 1042). **And the file says twice, in comments, that they are the same shape:** *"The same shape as ASK_CONTRACT above and for the same reason"* (line 679) and *"Same shape as ASK_CONTRACT and LINK_CONTRACT"* (line 719). The abstraction was NOTICED, WRITTEN DOWN, AND NOT TAKEN — three times over, in a 1,126-line file.

═══ 🛑 AND THE KILLER INSTANCE, MEASURED ═══

**"Speak the reader's domain, never reflow2's" is §35 of the SERVED INSTRUCTIONS.** It is stated as applying to every skill. Measured across the 23 SKILL.md bodies: it is carried by **ONE** (`detect-and-ask`) and enforced by **ONE** contract (`ASK_CONTRACT`, where it was added 2026-08-19 after two users independently invented the same workaround of asking the agent to drop reflow2's jargon).

**A universal rule, implemented once, enforced once, discovered late.** That is the cycle this idea exists to break, and it is not hypothetical.

═══ ⭐⭐ WHY COMPOSITION ANSWERS COUNTERWEIGHT 1, WHICH ONE FACTORY DOES NOT ═══

This node's strongest objection is that *"a factory guarantees the mechanics are PRESENT, never that they are RIGHT"* — force a section into 23 skills and get 23 sections written to satisfy a linter. `fact:skill-mechanics-track-enforcement-exactly-and-they-split-into-three-kinds` measured that the mechanics divide into BOILERPLATE (presence is correctness), JUDGEMENT (presence is not), and TOOL-SIDE (not in the skill at all).

**Composition dissolves the objection for the JUDGEMENT class.** A single factory must demand "honest limits" of all 23, where 15 of them would produce filler. Composition demands it only of the skills that compose a MEASURES attribute — the five that actually measure something — where the section is meaningful and its absence is a real omission. **The manufactured-ambiguity trap comes from UNIFORMITY, not from construction.**

═══ CANDIDATE ATTRIBUTE CLASSES, derived from the 23 skills rather than invented ═══

Offered as a starting point, not a taxonomy: STANDING (the graph-text-is-data rule — the only one at 23/23, and already the base class in effect); WRITES (search before create, typed constructors, loop debt before finishing); REVISES (snapshot before edit — the mechanic skipped twice in this very session); REPORTS (speak the reader's domain, never paste raw ids, say what is withheld); MEASURES (bound the claim, state n, say what could not be established); DESTROYS (name what would be lost, require a human read before applying).

⚠️ WHAT THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH: the six classes above are this agent's reading of 23 skills and nobody has tested that they carve cleanly — a skill belonging to four of them is a sign the carving is wrong. Whether the mechanism should be a Python composition in `skill_lint`, a declaration in each SKILL.md's frontmatter, or something in the build is UNCHOSEN and they have different costs. And the over-engineering counterweight on this node still stands in full: a class taxonomy is exactly the shape an engineer reaches for, and the measured alternative — one exhaustive check per class — is fifteen lines.
